properties.label: Message of the day
properties.description: The two lines players see under the server name in their server list.

properties.label: Server name
properties.description: The name shown in the Bedrock server list. Section-sign colour codes work here.

properties.label: Maximum players
properties.description: How many players can be online at once.

properties.label: Show in server list
properties.description: Answer server-list pings. Turned off, the server shows as offline but players can still join.

properties.label: Hide online players
properties.description: Leave the player names out of the server-list hover.

properties.label: Query protocol
properties.description: Answer GameSpy4 query requests, which server-list sites use to read the full player list.

properties.label: Visible on LAN
properties.description: Show the server in the Friends tab of players on the same network.

properties.label: Port
properties.description: Set by your server's allocation in the Network tab.

properties.label: Game mode
properties.description: The mode new players start in.

properties.label: Game mode
properties.description: The mode new players start in.

properties.label: Force game mode
properties.description: Put players back in the default game mode every time they join.

properties.label: Difficulty
properties.description: How hard mobs hit and how fast hunger drains.

properties.label: Hardcore
properties.description: Players are switched to spectator when they die, and difficulty is locked to hard.

properties.label: PvP
properties.description: Let players hurt each other.

properties.label: Allow flight
properties.description: Stop the server kicking survival players who appear to fly. Turn on when mods or plugins add flight.

properties.label: Allow cheats
properties.description: Let operators use commands such as /gamemode and /give.

properties.label: Allow the Nether
properties.description: Let players travel to the Nether.

properties.label: Spawn protection
properties.description: Radius around spawn, in blocks, that only operators can build in. 0 turns it off.

properties.label: Command blocks
properties.description: Let command blocks run commands.

properties.label: Spawn monsters
properties.description: Let hostile mobs spawn. Newer versions use a game rule instead.

properties.label: Spawn animals
properties.description: Let animals spawn. Newer versions use a game rule instead.

properties.label: Spawn villagers
properties.description: Let villagers spawn. Newer versions use a game rule instead.

properties.label: Chat restriction
properties.description: Limit or turn off chat for everyone.

properties.label: Disable player interaction
properties.description: Players ignore each other, as if alone in the world.

properties.label: World name
properties.description: The folder the world is saved in. A new name creates a new world on the next start.

properties.label: Seed
properties.description: The seed for new worlds. Leave empty for a random one. Only used when a world is created.

properties.label: World type
properties.description: The generator for new worlds. Only used when a world is created.

properties.label: Generate structures
properties.description: Generate villages, temples and other structures in new chunks.

properties.label: World border radius
properties.description: The furthest the world border can reach from the centre, in blocks.

properties.label: View distance
properties.description: How many chunks around each player are sent to them.

properties.label: Simulation distance
properties.description: How many chunks around each player keep ticking: mobs move and crops grow.

properties.label: View distance
properties.description: The furthest view distance players may use, in chunks.

properties.label: Tick distance
properties.description: How many chunks around each player keep ticking.

properties.label: Resource pack URL
properties.description: A direct download link to a resource pack players are offered when they join.

properties.label: Resource pack SHA-1
properties.description: The pack's SHA-1 hash, so players only download it again when it changes.

properties.label: Require resource pack
properties.description: Disconnect players who decline the resource pack.

properties.label: Require texture packs
properties.description: Players must accept the world's texture packs to join.

properties.label: Compression threshold
properties.description: Packets larger than this many bytes are compressed. -1 turns compression off.

properties.label: Compression threshold
properties.description: Packets larger than this many bytes are compressed.

properties.label: Watchdog timeout
properties.description: Milliseconds a single tick may take before the server stops itself. -1 turns the watchdog off.

properties.label: Entity range
properties.description: How far away entities are sent to players, as a percentage of the default.

properties.label: Synchronous chunk writes
properties.description: Write chunks to disk right away. Safer, but slower.

properties.label: Native networking
properties.description: Use Linux's faster network transport when it is available.

properties.label: Packet rate limit
properties.description: Kick players sending more packets per second than this. 0 turns it off.

properties.label: Chained block updates
properties.description: Limit on consecutive block updates before the rest are skipped. Negative turns it off.

properties.label: Region compression
properties.description: How chunks are compressed on disk.

properties.label: Maximum threads
properties.description: Threads the server may use. 0 uses as many as it can.

properties.label: Whitelist
properties.description: Only people listed in whitelist.json can connect.

properties.label: Kick when removed from whitelist
properties.description: Players taken off the whitelist are disconnected right away.

properties.label: Allowlist
properties.description: Only people listed in allowlist.json can connect.

properties.label: Premium accounts only
properties.description: Check every player against Mojang. Turning this off lets unpaid accounts in, so signed chat is switched off with it.

properties.label: Xbox sign-in required
properties.description: Players must be signed in to Xbox Live to join.

properties.label: Signed chat
properties.description: Requires a Mojang-signed chat key. Bedrock and offline players cannot join while this is on.

properties.label: Operator level
properties.description: What /op grants by default.

properties.label: Function level
properties.description: The permission level datapack functions run with.

properties.label: Default permission
properties.description: The permission level new players get.

properties.label: AFK kick after
properties.description: Minutes a player can stay inactive before being kicked. Set 0 to never kick.

properties.label: AFK kick after
properties.description: Minutes a player can stay inactive before being kicked. Set 0 to never kick.

properties.label: Block VPN connections
properties.description: Refuse players whose address differs from the one Mojang saw at sign-in.

properties.label: Console output to operators
properties.description: Show console command output to online operators.

properties.label: Log IP addresses
properties.description: Write player IP addresses to the server log.

properties.label: Disable custom skins
properties.description: Only allow skins from the Minecraft Marketplace and the default skins.

properties.label: Allow the End
properties.description: Let players travel to the End.

properties.label: Ticks per second
properties.description: How fast the game runs. 20 is normal speed; higher speeds the whole world up.

properties.label: Save player data
properties.description: Keep inventories, positions and health between sessions.

properties.label: Accept transfers
properties.description: Let other servers send players here with the transfer command.

properties.label: Chat reporting
properties.description: Sign chat messages so players can report them to Mojang.

properties.label: Chat format
properties.description: How chat lines look. {DISPLAYNAME} is the player, {MESSAGE} what they wrote.

properties.label: Resource pack message
properties.description: The text players see when they are asked to download the resource pack.
